standard.notes: bug fix, small feature, refactor, test fix; GLM 5.3 first, then MiniMax, GPT 6.1 Terra, Cursor, Claude

risky.notes: money or trade execution, state machines, concurrency, auth, secrets, migrations, deploy or CI pipelines, data deletion

design.notes: multi-file design, new module, cross-repo plan; the brief makes it plan first and get the plan reviewed before code

large.notes: features touching many files or parts; GLM 5.3 first (Shyam, 2026-11-04), judged by Sol

ui.notes: screens, components, styling, visual bugs; GLM 5.3 first

research.notes: gather facts, compare tools, read docs; no code changes; GLM 5.3 first

rca.notes: explain a failure, find a root cause; read-only at first; GLM 5.3 first

chore.notes: stale PR triage, docs, labels, small config, watches, status checks; MiniMax first

review.notes: the separate review thread; GLM 5.3 or MiniMax first, then GPT 6.1 (Shyam, 2026-11-04); the coordinator picks a vendor different from the author; never Cursor

panel.notes: second opinion or panel: not routed here, pass an explicit modelSelection per seat
